answer: Treat the trust graph as an atlas of who-vouched-for-whom. Honest newcomers attach to the mainland through non-kin attestations; a sybil ring, lacking real edges, clusters as an isolated island cut off by a canyon of missing cross-links. Eligibility then requires K attesters that bridge that canyon, established and non-kin, so a self-referential island can never grade itself into the payout set.
